news.q: Victor Wembanyama scored a career-high 52 points in the Spurs' 112-111 win over the Mavericks on Nov. 4. How many rebounds did he grab?
news.fact: He also blocked eight shots in 34 minutes.

news.q: NASA's Swift space telescope fell back to Earth on Nov. 4 after a planned rescue mission never happened. In what year did it launch?
news.fact: Swift spent almost 22 years hunting gamma-ray bursts, the universe's most powerful explosions.

easy.q: How many fingers does Homer Simpson have on each hand?
easy.fact: Most cartoon characters get four fingers, since they're easier to draw.

easy.q: How many years long is one term for a U.S. senator?
easy.fact: A third of the Senate is up for election every two years.

easy.q: How many seconds long could a Vine video be?
When it's noon in New York, what hour is it in London most of the year?
easy.fact: London is five hours ahead of New York for most of the year.

easy.q: How many teams play in England's Premier League?
easy.fact: The bottom three get relegated every season.

medium.q: How many yards wide is an NFL field, to the nearest yard?

How many players are on each Ryder Cup team?
medium.fact: The U.S. plays a team from Europe every two years.

medium.q: How many slots are in a standard Connect Four grid?
medium.fact: It's seven columns by six rows.

medium.q: How many states does Australia have?
medium.fact: It also has two mainland territories.

hard.q: How many stars were on the flag that inspired The Star-Spangled Banner?
hard.fact: It also had 15 stripes, one for each state.
